meta.title: Alexandre Majeau | Google Ads and Meta Ads Consultant for Online Sports Stores
meta.description: I run Google and Facebook advertising for online sports stores. More sales from the same ad budget.

hero.role: Google Ads and Meta Ads consultant for sports stores
hero.lede: I run your Google and Facebook campaigns, and every month you see what they bring in.

services.title: What I do for you
services.shoppingTitle: Your products show up more than once when a customer searches for them
services.shoppingText: I set up your catalogue in Merchant Center with a listing for every colour and size.
services.searchTitle: You show up when a customer searches for what you sell
services.searchText: I choose the keywords that lead to sales and drop the ones that cost money without bringing any in.
services.socialText: I show your products to people who don't know you yet, then follow up until they buy, without wearing them out.
services.trackTitle: You know what each campaign brings in
services.trackText: I set up Google Analytics 4 and send you a clear report every month.
services.scope: For your website or your branding, I refer you to specialists I work with.

results.label: Primeau Vélo, bike retailer · 2023 to 2026
results.title: My campaign results
results.bib1: in sales generated by advertising over three years
results.bib2Plain: Every dollar invested now brings in 8 times more than in 2023.
results.note: These results come from the four services described above.
results.quote: [Quote from a Primeau Vélo manager about Alex's work]
results.panelCta: What if it were your store?

jargon.title: ROI, ROAS, CPA, CPM… All Greek to you?
jargon.intro: I read these numbers every day. You have a store to run. I translate each one into a clear sentence: what you paid, what it brought in and what I'm changing.

method.title: How we work together
method.s1Text: You tell me about your store and your goals, and I tell you whether I can help.
method.s2Text: You get a list of the spending that isn't generating sales.
method.s3Text: You approve the plan, then I launch the campaigns.
method.s4Text: I adjust the campaigns every week and you get a report at the end of the month.

about.title: Why work with me
about.r1Title: I know e-commerce from the inside
about.r1Text: For more than three years, I ran the advertising and product listings of an online retailer. I factor your margins and inventory into every campaign.
about.r2Text: The person answering your emails is the one running your campaigns.
about.r3Title: I work in English and French
about.r3Text: Your campaigns can reach customers anywhere in Canada.
about.fact1: Advertising and search specialist since 2024, e-commerce content coordinator from 2023 to 2024
about.fact2: College certificate (AEC) in e-commerce coordination, Cégep de l'Outaouais

booking.title: 30 minutes to see what your advertising could bring in
booking.lede: The call is free, with no commitment. Beforehand, I look at your online store so I come with specific questions. If I can't help you, I'll tell you.
booking.role: Google Ads and Meta Ads consultant, Blainville

footer.about: Google Ads and Meta Ads consultant for online sports stores. Based in Blainville, on Montreal's North Shore.

items.q: How much do your services cost?
items.a: My engagements start at $[X] per month. The price depends on the number of platforms and the size of your catalogue. Your ad budget is paid directly to Google and Meta.
I recommend at least $[X] per month. With less, the platforms don't have enough data to deliver your ads well.

items.q: How long before I see results?
items.a: The first adjustments often show results within a few weeks. A complete strategy takes two to three months to fine-tune.

items.q: Do you work with Shopify, WooCommerce or Magento?
items.a: Yes. I worked on Magento at Primeau Vélo and studied Shopify and WordPress in college. Campaigns work the same way on all of these platforms.
They stay in your name. If you end our engagement, you keep the history and the campaigns.

items.q: Do you only work with sports stores?
items.a: That's where I have the most experience. If your store sells something else, email me and I'll tell you whether I can help.
